_comment: The allowlist of packs the NPC body build may read (openspec/changes/npc-characters, design section 2). Each pack is pinned by the SHA-256 of its download. tools/deps/fetch_character_tools.py fetches them into a cache outside the repository and refuses a pack whose hash differs; tools/blender/build_npcs.py and build_npc_clips.py resolve every asset they read against these packs only. The GPL tool never ships: only its output does, and its authors claim nothing over output.

packs.name: MPFB 2.0.17, the MakeHuman plugin for Blender
packs.licence: code GPL-3.0-or-later; its data (base mesh, targets, rigs, weights) CC0; output unclaimed
packs.licence_stated_in: https://github.com/makehumancommunity/mpfb2/blob/master/LICENSE.md, and the extension listing (SPDX GPL-3.0-or-later for the code)

packs.name: MakeHuman system assets, the CC0 pack (skins, eyes, brows, lashes, hair, proxies, clothes)
packs.licence_stated_in: The pack page, which lists every asset in it with the licence CC0 (the page field), and MPFB's licence page, https://github.com/makehumancommunity/mpfb2/blob/master/LICENSE.md. Its 147 asset files carry no licence lines of their own, so the licence is checked per pack, not per file.

packs.name: Universal Animation Library, Standard (Quaternius), the 2025-03-25 build
packs._comment_fetch: Pinned to the build the spike measured and game/animations/ual/ ships. On 2026-09-28 the only download (quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library, upload 'Universal Animation Library[Standard].zip') serves a newer build: UAL1_Standard.glb dated 2026-06-16, SHA-256 cc73fc4e495b82958207316596317a3f40b9fa38065bde1027937452da537724, with a different file layout. So this pin can't be downloaded any more, and the fetch asks for a verified copy in the cache instead of fetching a different file.
packs.licence_stated_in: Animation Library[Standard]/License.txt inside the zip, and the pack page
